prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='DWT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) matching y_true's consistent downward trend across both folds. DWT_catboost leads in seasonality capture (0.7422 correlation) while ONLY_DWT_catboost delivers the lowest overall RMSE (0.7762). The split between trend and seasonality champions, combined with high model disagreement and concept drift detection, makes STL-hierarchical stacking ideal for exploiting decomposition-aware combination while handling non-stationarity.
